segments.text: All of us want to be superheroes, and the most important heroes are those that help others.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_03

segments.text: This year, thousands of kids like us around the world joined the COVID-19 vaccine trial.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_03

segments.text: To all the kids who volunteered, we'd like to say...
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_03

segments.text: But one day I had a stomach ache so bad I didn't want to do anything.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_02

segments.text: The team at New York Presbyterian said it was actually my heart.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_02

segments.text: But doctors gave me medicines and used machines to control my heartbeat.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_02

segments.text: So now I can become the next great fashion designer.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_02

segments.text: Two teenage boys who died on days three and four after the Pfizer vaccine and the parents were horrified to find the children dead at home.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Autopsies were performed and the conclusion was crystal clear the vaccines caused the death with massive heart inflammation.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I took care of those children who came in with myocarditis after the vaccine.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01

segments.text: And I talked to the doctors because I was a charge nurse saying, why aren't we reporting these to VAERS?
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01

segments.text: Who is going to report these to VAERS?
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01

segments.text: It was an unspoken thing that we were not allowed to talk about openly on the unit.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01

segments.text: The day before I was taken away from my position, I was actively giving compressions to a child to keep him alive.
